expires_today.title: Dark Places and Endless Night: Sheer Horror by IDW
expires_today.long_description: The days are getting colder, the nights are getting longer, and spooky season is officially upon us. Lean into the scary vibes with this bundle of horror comics and graphic novels from IDW! Explore an idyllic small town of anthropomorphic animals protected by a serial killer bear in the Richard Scarry-esque murder mystery Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees! Follow an all-women crew of inmate firefighters as they stage a heist during a rampaging California wildfire in the first of Scott Snyder’s anthology series Dark Spaces: Wildfire! Discover the truth of a strange sleeping illness in the graphic novel adaptation of Stephen and Owen King’s Sleeping Beauties! Survive the bloody horrors of the vampire-infested Alaska town in the Deluxe Edition of 30 Days of Night! All of these and more are included in this spooky bundle of horror comics, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Best of Brian W. Aldiss by Open Road Media
expires_today.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen it before
expires_today.long_description: Far off worlds! Dangerous Edens! The future of humanity and beyond! Read the works of a true master of science fiction with this massive bundle of ebooks by Brian W. Aldiss! Visit a planet with seasons that last for centuries and civilizations in constant conflict in Helliconia Spring! Discover the secrets behind a mad scientist’s beastly creations in An Island Called Moreau! Follow a utopian Mars colony as they fight to survive against insurmountable odds in Finches of Mars! All of these adventures and more are included in this bundle of over 40 fantastic ebooks by a true master of the genre. Get them now at the price of your choosing, and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
expires_today.long_description: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! Lose yourself in the complete Astro City series! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Or explore The Autumnlands, an epic tale that melds mature themes with high‑fantasy wizardry! Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Picture Perfect - The Ultimate Photo & Video Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Enhance your photos and videos like a pro
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Give your photos and videos the polish they need with this bundle of editing software from Ashampoo! Take screenshots and annotate images and screengrabs with Snap Pro 26, get rid of glare and blurred lines with SHARPEN #6, choose what part of an image to highlight in high resolution with ZOOM #3, and more! Organize your library, denoise your photos, and add vibrancy and color to all of your digital projects with this bundle of professional tools at an accessible price! Grab this collection of Ashampoo apps and plugins for the price of your choice, and support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate Gene Wolfe Library by Tor Books
expires_tomorrow.description: New suns, ancient lands, and beyond
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Sci-fi and fantasy master Gene Wolfe’s novels and long-running series span all facets of genre fiction, each one unlike anything else ever written. For anyone looking to get into one of the greats, we’ve partnered with Tor Books to bring you the best of Gene Wolfe in one massive library! Enter the world of the genre-bending Book of the New Sun series with the Dying Earth fantasy of Shadow and Claw! Travel back to Ancient Greece with an amnesiac mercenary manipulated by the gods in Soldier of the Mist! Meet a young boy destined to become a warrior and more in the mythology remix The Knight! Nearly 40 novels, short story collections, and more are featured in this truly giant bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Alzheimer’s Research UK with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: 2D Rewind Collection from S2 Games
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Transport yourself back to the good old days with this bundle of arcade-inspired fun! From pixelated beat-’em-ups to combat strategy games, this bundle has plenty of retro delights for the modern day. Hit the streets with the hot-blooded scrappers of River City Girls and River City Girls 2! Traverse the endless void in an evolving spaceship in Nova Drift! Play the slots and build your deck to make rent money in Luck Be a Landlord. Special thanks to S2 Games for making this collection possible! There’s even more 2D adventure to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and help support the Starlight Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Ultimate SFX for Games
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Function Loops has assembled a massive collection that brings together 3 bundles and 44 packs total, including fresh sample packs never released before. On top of that, they’ve added a brand new VST plugin, loaded with 4 expansions for drums & percussion design. Spanning retro production, cinematic scoring, drums & percussion, game sounds & FX, ambiences, and modern electronic sound design, this bundle delivers over $1,500 USD worth of sounds and tools, ready to drop into your next video game, soundtrack, or production. Plus, a portion of your purchase benefits Music Will and their goal of spreading music education to all.

expires_tomorrow.title: Joe Haldeman: The Forever War and Beyond by Open Road Media
expires_tomorrow.description: The future worlds of Joe Haldeman
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Meet one of the masters of science fiction in this collection of books by the one and only Joe Haldeman! See where it all started with his Nebula, Hugo, and Locus Award winning novel The Forever War, a drama of civilizations trapped in interstellar conflict! Embark on a nailbiting trip to the surface of a future Earth threatened by a terrorist plot in Worlds! Follow an intergalactic spy wracked with guilt over dangerous missions in All My Sins Remembered! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of 17 of Joe Haldeman’s greatest sci-fi stories, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Best Core Game Dev Assets & Tools Megabundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: If you’ve got the narrative, we’ve got the assets and toolkits to bring your next game idea to reality! The Best Core Game Dev Assets & Tools bundle includes Hyper Combat Framework, Attribute Manager, Building and Farming systems. Also included are environment packs for a myriad of locales like space, feudal Japanese villages, ancient forests, and more. Get over $2700 worth of game development assistance, all while supporting Girls Who Code with your purchase. <iframe width="400" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YCFketQ0KqA?si=Ozmc5xwBZxpUh5SR" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

expires_tomorrow.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: SkullForge Studios Arsenal Mega Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Pay what you want for the ultimate collection of Arsenal printable minis for any occasion or the hit tabletop skirmish game by SkullForge Studios! This action-packed game pits fireteams of badass mercenaries against each other for contract payouts and glory. Each fireteam plays 5 drop troopers and 1 mega mech known as MCVs. Our Mega Bundle assembles hundreds of unique playables from terrain to vanguards like Arsenal Terrain: Mech Bay and Crew and Arsenal Fireteam: Zeta. Dominate the combat zone alongside your friends and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: 50 Essential Fantagraphics Titles by Fantagraphics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: A classic alien invasion thriller! An iconic Sunday strip adventure! A murder investigation with a pulpy twist! When it comes to publishing great comics, Fantagraphics knows what’s up, and if you’ve been looking to get into what this fantastic publisher has to offer, we’ve collected 50 of Fantagraphics’ best titles in one bundle! Solve the murder of a mysterious woman alongside a horror-obsessed 10-year-old in My Favorite Thing Is Monsters! Escape to an era of medieval swordfights and epic adventures with the first two collected volumes of Prince Valiant! Fight back against a devastating alien invasion in the subversive Argentine masterwork The Eternaut! All of these and many more are featured in this bundle of 50—yes, F-I-F-T-Y—of Fantagraphics’ best titles, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom of the Press Foundation with your purchase!
